entries.target: Ang 尊敬語 ay itinataas ang action ng iba; ang 謙譲語 ay ibinababa ang action ng sarili/sariling grupo—pareho ang layunin: panatilihing mataas ang posisyon ng iginagalang na tao. Kaya bago isasaulo ang verb, kilalanin ang actor at kung kanino patungo ang action.

entries.source: Humble action সাধারণত সম্মানিত ব্যক্তির দিকে যায় বা তার সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত: お客様をご案内します, 先生に伺います। একা ঘরে 私はテレビを拝見します বললে relation না থাকায় অতিরিক্ত/অস্বাভাবিক হতে পারে।
entries.target: Ang humble action ay karaniwang patungo sa iginagalang na tao o may kaugnayan sa kanya: お客様をご案内します, 先生に伺います. Kung sasabihin nang mag-isa sa kuwarto ang 私はテレビを拝見します, maaaring maging labis/hindi natural dahil walang relation.

entries.source: Outsider-এর সঙ্গে কথা বললে নিজের boss/company in-group; তার action-ও humble/neutral: 部長の田中が伺います। নিজের boss-কে outsider-এর সামনে いらっしゃる দিয়ে উঁচু করবেন না।
entries.target: Kung makikipag-usap sa outsider, ang sariling boss/company ay in-group; ang action niya ay humble/neutral din: 部長の田中が伺います. Huwag itaas ang sariling boss gamit ang いらっしゃる sa harap ng outsider.

entries.source: いたす হলো する-এর humble special verb; おVいたします/ごNいたします আরও formal। একই বাক্যে প্রয়োজনহীন prefix stacking এড়ান।
entries.target: Ang いたす ay humble special verb ng する; ang おVいたします/ごNいたします ay mas pormal. Iwasan ang hindi kailangang prefix stacking sa parehong pangungusap.

entries.source: এক mora stem বা special humble verb-এ mechanical pattern নয়: 見る→お見します ✕, 拝見します; 来る→お来します ✕, 参ります/伺います。
entries.target: Sa isang mora stem o special humble verb, hindi mekanikal ang pattern: 見る→お見します ✕, 拝見します; 来る→お来します ✕, 参ります/伺います.

entries.source: おVになります = অন্যের honorific; おVします = নিজের humble।
entries.target: Ang おVになります = honorific ng iba; ang おVします = humble ng sarili.

entries.target: Ang する-noun ay karaniwang ご: ご説明します; ang exceptions tulad ng お電話します ay fixed usage.

entries.source: 参る হলো 行く/来る-এর humble-politeness; 伺う destination/person-এর কাছে যাওয়া, জিজ্ঞেস/শোনা—সম্মানিত counterpart স্পষ্ট।
entries.target: Ang 参る ay humble-politeness ng 行く/来る; ang 伺う ay pagpunta sa destination/person, pagtatanong/pakikinig—malinaw ang iginagalang na counterpart.

entries.source: 申す self-introduction/name: 田中と申します। 申し上げる recipient-directed ‘বলছি/জানাচ্ছি’ আরও humble: 心よりお礼申し上げます।
entries.target: Ang 申す ay self-introduction/name: 田中と申します. Ang 申し上げる ay recipient-directed na 'sinasabi ko/ipinapaalam ko' na mas humble: 心よりお礼申し上げます.

entries.source: 存じています = তথ্য জানি; 存じ上げています = ব্যক্তিকে চিনি (আরও respectful)। N4 core-এ 存じています চিনুন।
entries.target: Ang 存じています = alam ko ang impormasyon; ang 存じ上げています = kilala ko ang tao (mas respectful). Sa N4 core, kilalanin ang 存じています.

entries.source: いただく তিন অর্থে দেখা যায়: গ্রহণ করা (humble もらう), খাওয়া/পান করা (humble), favor গ্রহণ (Vていただく)।
entries.target: Ang いただく ay nakikita sa tatlong kahulugan: pagtanggap (humble na もらう), pagkain/pag-inom (humble), pagtanggap ng pabor (Vていただく).
Ang 伺う = visit/ask/hear—tingnan ang object/destination context.

entries.target: Ang polite progressive ng おる ay おります: 田中は席を外しております.

entries.source: ございます = あります-এর 丁寧語: 在庫がございます, お時間はございますか। এটি necessarily humble নয়; খুব formal polite।
entries.target: Ang ございます = 丁寧語 ng あります: 在庫がございます, お時間はございますか. Hindi ito kinakailangang humble; ito ay napakapormal na polite.

entries.source: でございます = です-এর formal রূপ: 私は田中でございます, 会場はこちらでございます। Customer service/announcement-এ বহুল।
entries.target: Ang でございます = pormal na anyo ng です: 私は田中でございます, 会場はこちらでございます. Madalas ito sa customer service/announcement.

entries.source: মানুষ/প্রাণীর existence-এ সাধারণত いらっしゃいます (সম্মানিত) বা おります (নিজে/in-group), ございます নয়।
entries.target: Sa existence ng tao/hayop, karaniwang いらっしゃいます (iginagalang) o おります (sarili/in-group), hindi ございます.

entries.source: Double keigo এড়ান: おっしゃられる (おっしゃる＋passive honorific) prescriptively redundant; おっしゃる যথেষ্ট। お召し上がりになる-ও over-keigo; 召し上がる।
entries.target: Iwasan ang double keigo: ang おっしゃられる (おっしゃる＋passive honorific) ay prescriptively redundant; sapat na ang おっしゃる. Ang お召し上がりになる ay over-keigo rin; 召し上がる.
